title: VectorCraft stitch style file (.vcstyle), version 1
description: A named set of stitch settings, copied onto objects when applied. See vcstyle.md.

id.description: Lower-case letters and digits joined by dashes; made from name when absent or empty.

stitch.description: The settings, as an object's stitch settings; startAt, angles, rails, trimBefore, trimAfter and stopBefore are left out when read.
